name: Clean Trust
brief:
Aesthetic: Flat Design (2D, minimalist, bold colors, no shadows, clean lines, simple shapes, typography-focused)
Pattern: Trust & Authority + Conversion. Hero (mission/credibility) > Proof (certs, stats) > Solution overview > Clear CTA path. CTA: Get Quote (primary) + Nav.
Color strategy: Professional blue + urgent orange. Accent for CTA only.
Typography: Lexend / Source Sans 3 (Corporate Trust: trustworthy, accessible, readable).
Key effects: No gradients/shadows, simple hover (color/opacity shift), fast loading, clean transitions (150-200ms ease), minimal icons.
Never: Hidden contact info, No certifications, Emoji as icons, Text under 12px, Removing focus rings, Horizontal scroll.
heroTreatment: Two columns on a pale blue ground: headline, subhead, orange booking button and blue call button on the left; the trade photo on the right in a plain rectangle with a 2px blue rule. No overlay on the photo. Mobile stacks the photo above the copy at a short height so the trust strip and services heading stay in the fold.

name: Bold Local
brief:
Aesthetic: Brutalism (raw, stark, high contrast, plain text, visible borders, asymmetric)
Pattern: Trust & Authority + Conversion. Hero > Proof > Solution overview > Clear CTA path.
Color strategy: Industrial navy + safety orange, high contrast, accent for CTA only.
Typography: Barlow Condensed / Barlow (condensed for impact headlines, regular for body).
Key effects: Sharp corners (0px), bold typography (700+), visible 2-4px borders, large blocks, instant or near-instant transitions.
Never: Hidden contact info, No certifications, Rounded-everything, Soft shadows, Pastel palettes, Decorative gradients.
heroTreatment: Full-bleed trade photo with no filter and a bottom-left navy gradient capped at 0.35; the copy sits on an opaque navy block anchored bottom-left with a 4px orange top rule, condensed uppercase headline, orange booking button, white outline call button. Mobile: photo band on top with a 4px orange rule under it, navy block below.

name: Premium Dark
brief:
Aesthetic: Dark Mode (OLED) (deep black, dark grey, high contrast, low white emission, visible focus)
Pattern: Trust & Authority + Conversion with a premium register. Hero > Proof > Solution overview > Clear CTA path.
Color strategy: Premium black + gold accent; gold reserved for the call to action and ratings.
Typography: Cormorant / Montserrat (Luxury Serif: elegant heading, geometric body).
Key effects: Minimal glow, dark-to-light transitions (200-300ms), hairline gold rules, no cheap visuals, no fast animations.
Never: Hidden contact info, No certifications, Cheap visuals, Fast animations, Gray-on-gray text, Neon accents.
heroTreatment: Dark page. Copy left with a tall serif headline, a gold booking button and an outlined call button; the trade photo right inside a hairline gold frame with a 0.25 black vignette at the lower edge only, no filter. Mobile: framed photo band on top at a short height, copy below.

name: Friendly Family
brief:
Aesthetic: Soft UI Evolution (improved contrast, subtle depth, rounded 8-16px, modern 200-300ms motion)
Pattern: Trust & Authority + Conversion in a neighborly register. Hero > Proof > Solution overview > Clear CTA path.
Color strategy: Family blue + amber accent on a near-white ground; amber only on the call to action and stars.
Typography: Varela Round / Nunito Sans (Soft Rounded: friendly, approachable, warm).
Key effects: Soft multi-layer shadows with offset and blur, 16px radii, gentle hover lift, visible focus, measured contrast.
Never: Hidden contact info, No certifications, Sharp corners everywhere, Harsh black, Stock icon grids, Aggressive urgency.
heroTreatment: Photo left in a 24px-radius card with a soft offset shadow, copy right with a rounded headline, amber booking button and blue call button; no overlay or filter on the photo. Mobile: rounded photo band on top at a short height, copy below.

name: Modern Minimal
brief:
Aesthetic: Minimalism & Swiss Style (clean, spacious, functional, white space, high contrast, geometric, grid-based)
Pattern: Trust & Authority + Conversion. Hero > Proof > Solution overview > Clear CTA path.
Color strategy: Neutral grey + link blue; a single accent, used for the call to action and links only.
Typography: Outfit / Work Sans (Geometric Modern: clean, balanced, contemporary).
Key effects: Subtle hover (200-250ms), 1px hairline borders, no shadows, 0-2px radii, clear type hierarchy.
Never: Hidden contact info, No certifications, Shadows and gradients, Decorative ornament, More than one accent, Centered everything.
heroTreatment: Left-aligned copy across the top of a hairline grid, blue booking button and outlined call button, then the trade photo as a wide panoramic band under the copy with no filter or overlay. Mobile: the same order at a shorter band height.
